description: This PHP source file defines the 'Report' entity class for the OrangeHRM system, mapping to the 'ohrm_report' database table. It includes properties like 'id', 'name', 'reportGroup', 'useFilterField', and 'type', along with their respective getter and setter methods, and uses Doctrine ORM annotations for ORM mapping.

classes.name: Report
classes.description: Represents a report entity with properties such as id, name, associated report group, use filter flag, and type, mapped to the 'ohrm_report' database table.
